title: Enlarge from a card onto the card's source, with a transition and no reload

tasks.title: Enlarge from a card with a transition, onto the card's ref
End to end — enlarging lands on the card's source without a reload

acs.text: WHEN a plain click (or Enter) lands on a live room card's link THE SYSTEM SHALL enlarge into that room through the room controller (R9: one push with `ctx=social.room.<id>`, then the room's place applied with origin `follow`), using the card's ref as the target when the room's stream has no state yet, so the reader lands on the card's source; the document is not reloaded (no navigation of the page, the harness keeps its in-memory state) and Back returns to `/social`.
scenarios: Pressing a live card lands on its source without a reload

acs.text: WHEN the browser has `document.startViewTransition` THE SYSTEM SHALL run the enlarge inside a view transition in which the card is the named element and the update completes when the room's context is ready (at most 3 seconds); otherwise it SHALL animate the card with `transform` and `clip-path` towards the full viewport (at most 300 ms) and then enlarge.
scenarios: A view transition where supported, a transform elsewhere

acs.text: WHEN the person prefers reduced motion THE SYSTEM SHALL run no animation and no view transition, and enlarge at once.
WHEN the click is modified (Ctrl, Cmd, Shift, Alt or a middle click) THE SYSTEM SHALL leave it to the browser (the lobby link opens as a link) and not enlarge.
